scope: Nine additional verified SMA2/3/4 profiles; thirteen total with unchanged SMA1 profiles; not universal ROM support

implementation.driver: Original Nintendo music initialization/select/frame-update/PCM-mixer routines in user ROM
implementation.bootstrap: Own ARM emitter: existing VCOUNT-edge scheduler with optional original per-frame game-music update; original source bytes unchanged except reset branch in private memory copy; no game boot/save/BIOS/ROM writes
implementation.catalog: Original bounded music-ID mapping:48/40/57 for SMA2/3/4, includes aliases/jingles. Original upper playback flags retained; no zeroing as some local GSF rips did. No inferred sequencer track count; zero field means unavailable, not silent. Initial ID0.
implementation.identity: Full size+CRC matching only, not authenticity/security certification
implementation.channels: Six hardware channels4PSG+PCM A/B; per-instrument split and auxiliary bank discovery not implemented; existing GSF voice path unchanged

full_ctest.scope: Final runtime logic. Later test-runner-only AC metric enhancement did not change player binary.

actual_regional.checks: Distinct positive finite output, deterministic replay/exact500ms seek/all-channel mute/ID rejection/original bytes readback equality

sweep.checks: Subtract per-side mean and exclude first4096frames; idle DC not counted as musical variation

tests.initial_failure: First descriptor flag mask rejected valid original high-byte flags1/3. Corrected allowed original flag sets per verified profile, not source music/driver patch. Failure log preserved privately.
tests.native_ROM_GUI: Prior test1 frontend/user confirmation reused. No new per-ROM GUI run in this iteration; only data/routine profiles and existing menu path changed.
tests.packaged_UI: Do not repeat user-confirmed functionality; --skip-ui records no fresh packaged UI checks. PE/import/CRC/source/assets checks remain.

limitations: Only13 exact profiles; arbitrary GBA/other-console ROMs unsupported
No original song titles/durations or universal loop detection
Each145USentry tested at beginning only; regional variants two representative songs each, not all full songs
Auxiliary music engines/banks in a ROM are not automatically enumerated
Six hardware buses, not instrument decomposition
Original in-game transient context/physical-console fidelity not established
user_policy: Default to tests unless explicit 배포본. Keep base1.6.2 and increment trailing test number. User-confirmed baseline should not be repeatedly retested; focus on unsupported-ROM implementation.
assets: All supplied ROM/GSF/sample bytes and temporary prototype GSFs remain private outside source/package; original files read-only. No new third-party dependency.
next: Broaden music-driver recognition for other GBA titles and separate auxiliary banks, then add other-console ROM execution; do not pretend signature matching alone establishes playback.
